description:
Emission zones list

Returns an overview of all environmental zones (low-emission and zero-emission
zones) in the Netherlands. Data comes from the NDW Open Data platform
(DATEX II format). Optionally paginate with `page` (plus `per_page`, max 500;
only then does the response contain a `meta` block). Filter by zone type or city.

Cost: 0.5 credit(s) per call. An API key is required via the X-Api-Key header (or Authorization: Bearer <key>); a per-call wallet payment via x402 is also accepted.
name: ndw.emissiezones
